task.title: Delete your profile
task.shortdesc: Remove everything keeps on this phone. This can't be undone.

step.cmd: Under Account, tap Delete my profile.
step.stepresult: The screen lists what is deleted and what other phones keep.

step.cmd: Type DELETE, then tap Delete my profile.
step.info: To cancel, tap Keep my profile.

taskbody.result: The app returns to the Welcome screen.

postreq.note: Deleting the app alone doesn't remove your recovery words; iOS keeps them. Use Delete my profile first if you want them gone.
